Package com.example.ecolums

Class Badge

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.Badge
public class Badge extends Object
Represents an achievement badge that a user can earn by meeting specific sustainability milestones or completing challenges.

Badges are stored as a sub-collection under each user's Firestore document and are also referenced from ProgressTracker when milestone checks run.
